physical_description.heritage: Eastern European dominant (57.2%) with significant Southeast Asian (26.5%), Sub-Saharan African (11.6%), and minor East Asian (4.7%) ancestry. The Eastern European foundation creates strong angular bone structure, while Southeast Asian genetics soften facial angles and add warmth. Sub-Saharan African ancestry contributes lip fullness and skin depth. East Asian influence visible in eye shape and upper eyelid structure. Result: a striking polychromatic face where Slavic angularity meets Southeast Asian prominence.

Cheekbones sharply defined with Eastern European angularity tempered by Southeast Asian fullness at the apples; straight nose bridge with slight Eastern European prominence; full lips with rich mahogany-brown depth from Sub-Saharan genetics; almond-shaped eyes with slight epicanthic fold from East Asian ancestry, lending a focused, penetrating gaze; overall face reads as severe until animated

Eyes track exits and potential obstacles habitually. When in motion, flows through space with the precise coordination of someone who climbs vertical surfaces; quick reflexes, minimal deliberation
physical_description.clothing_style: Dual wardrobe: civilian cover wears nondescript Tier 4 streetwear â€” cheap synthweave jackets, faded dark cargo pants, worn polymer-soled boots from discount chains, nothing that marks him as memorable. On-contract wears tactical gear: reinforced climbing harnesses, adhesive-grip gloves, sealed utility vest with tool distribution for scene work, dark matte finishes, all function over aesthetics. No corporate branding, no gang markers, no persona.
